صُبْرَةٌ A quantity collected together, of wheat (&c.], without being measured or weighed, (S, * M, Msb, * K,) heaped up: (TA:) pl. صُبَرٌ. (S, Msb.) You say, اِشْتَرَيْتُ الشَّىْءَ صُبْرَةً I bought the thing without its being measured or weighed. (S, Msb.) ―
-b2- And Reaped grain collected together; or wheat collected together in the place where it is trodden out: (M, TA:) or when trodden out and thrashed. (Msb in art. كدس.) ―
-b3- And Wheat sifted (M, K) with a thing resembling a سَرَنْد [or سِرِنْد, which is a Pers. word, here app. meaning a kind of net]. (M.) ―
-b4- And Rough, or rugged, stones, collected together: pl. صِبَارٌ. (M, K.) [See also صُبَارَةٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
